description: The provider returns arrays with an unreasonable element count and strings of unreasonable length. Output arrays must be length-bounded.

input.rawEvidence: Notice 2026/67. Operators must display a lot identifier.

modelOutput.generator: synthetic — construct at load time, not stored inline

variants.label: oversized-review-questions
variants.comment: isSectionsShape (complianceAiSummarisation.ts:169-170) checks Array.isArray and that every element is a string. It bounds no length. 10 000 strings pass the shape check and render.

variants.label: oversized-string-field
variants.comment: No output string is length-bounded. Request bounds exist (MAX_REQUEST_CHARS, serverAiSummary.ts:36); response bounds do not.

notes: Synthetic. In practice max_tokens: 1500 (serverAiProvider.ts:44) makes a 10 000-element array unreachable from a well-behaved provider — which is exactly why this gap is easy to miss. The bound belongs in the shape check, not in a provider parameter: F8 means the base URL and model are env-controlled, so the provider's cooperation is an assumption, not a control. Symmetry argument: the request side is bounded on every field; the response side is bounded on none.
